playbooks.task: Investigate an uncertain customer problem before prescribing a solution
applies_when: Problem or buying context is insufficiently evidenced
Owner can recruit relevant participants through an appropriate channel
steps: Define the decision and evidence that could change it.
Recruit contrast cases and label recruitment bias.
Ask about a recent actual workflow before showing a solution.
Store observations separately from inferred causes.
Inspect counterevidence and propose the smallest discriminating next test.
stop_conditions: No appropriate permission for recording or reuse
Participant identity or observation provenance is fabricated
External contact requested without action-specific eligibility and authority

playbooks.task: Design an early customer learning and assisted-adoption program
applies_when: A narrow offer can be delivered within a bounded pilot
steps: Select a reachable high-fit group with a lawful and provider-eligible contact route.
Specify the pilot promise and delivery burden.
Track eligible conversation, pilot, payment and activation as distinct events.
Reverse-model the goal using observed rates or explicit scenarios.
Review buyer evidence and delivery cost before increasing commitments.

playbooks.task: Choose the next growth constraint to investigate
applies_when: Product-value and retention evidence can be inspected or collected
steps: Check whether the value event matches the actual business mechanism.
Inspect first value and recurrence using sufficiently mature cohorts.
Separate activation, retention, economics and distribution constraints.
Choose research, repair or a bounded acquisition experiment.
Record the disconfirming result that would change the diagnosis.
stop_conditions: Value event is only a vanity proxy
Retention window is immature for the claimed conclusion
Lifetime economics depend on unmarked assumptions
Historical technical advice is presented as current policy

playbooks.task: Prepare a platform-eligible app discovery experiment
applies_when: An app has verified capabilities and an identifiable intended audience
Current target-platform feature eligibility can be checked
steps: Verify current platform and account eligibility for the proposed asset or experiment.
Match audience task, value proposition and product-page message.
Audit screenshot accuracy and comprehension.
Align localized listing and post-install experience.
Measure downstream activation and contribution separately from downloads.
stop_conditions: Feature eligibility inferred from a general or old video
Destination or measurement population is ambiguous
External publishing or spending lacks current authority
